2026-09-25.patch_summary: This patch series addresses poor NUMA balancing behavior in a production deployment by modifying the VMA scan filters to no longer gate memory-tier promotion. The issue arises from the global balancing mode not being able to describe the intent of individual VMA/PTE walks, leading to unproductive socket-placement faults that prevent promotion. The patches introduce promotion-only NUMA protection walks and derive private VMA state in the folio eligibility check, allowing eligible shared folios to be promoted to a fast tier. Additionally, the patches separate VMA placement eligibility from partial-scan continuation and scan PID-inactive VMAs for promotion. The changes improve DRAM bandwidth, reduce CXL bandwidth saturation, and decrease request latency.
